The page date is the machine-readable <time datetime> — 2026-09-02T10:10:21Z / 10:10:25Z / 10:10:25Z, unchanged from the stored asOf — NOT the rendered "Updated 6 hours ago" string, which disagrees with it and would have stamped today on a three-day-old cut. COUNT RECONCILIATION CAUGHT A PARSER BUG BEFORE THE MERGE, and it is worth recording: the first pass anchored on <a class="..."meta-item and returned 26/6/6 = 38 instead of 27/7/6 = 40, because the top-ranked entry on each page writes href BEFORE class. Re-anchored on <a [^>]*meta-item, the counts reconcile at 27/7/6 = 40 with 0 unmatched — and the two specs that had silently dropped were Augmentation Evoker and Restoration Shaman, the latter being the #1 healer, i.e. exactly the rows a shortfall hides. Merged as "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" keeping the ceiling wording; asOf held at the source's 2026-09-02.
